hook: Your walk through Nicosia can cross a border.
title: You can walk across the last divided capital
description:
Nicosia, the capital of Cyprus, is the last divided capital in the world. A UN buffer zone runs through the city, and you can see the barriers on the streets. Berlin was once split too, but it reunited, and Nicosia is still divided.

#Shorts #Cyprus #Geography
comment_prompt: Would you walk across it? Yes or no
